executiveSummary: The OT/ICS threat environment is elevated to CRITICAL driven by multiple, concurrent, and validated campaigns directly targeting control systems and critical infrastructure perimeters. Priority risks include: Active targeting of Siemens S7-200/300/400/1200/1500 PLCs using AI-assisted tooling (snap7-based) for read/write over S7comm, with specific detections and mitigations provided. Security Advisory Iranian-affiliated actors exploiting internet-exposed PLCs (Rockwell, Schneider, Siemens) to alter logic/AOIs and manipulate HMI/alarms, with confirmed operational impact in WWS and Energy. Security Advisory Pre-auth RCE in NetScaler ADC/Gateway (CVE-2026-8452) with public PoC and webshell activity; urgent patching and compromise assessment required. Security Advisory Large-scale EV charging infrastructure risk: multiple unauthenticated control/RCE paths in EV chargers and OCPP/WebSocket implementations enabling remote disruption. CISA Bulletin Fortinet "FortiBleed" credential leakage/exfiltration and domain credential interception via compromised FortiGate devices, enabling IT-to-OT pivot. Security Advisory Mitsubishi Electric FA network modules and PLC interface modules susceptible to remote UDP DoS requiring resets; patching and strict segmentation advised. ICS Advisory Fuel management system (Fuel-Boss) RCE via legacy PHP/IMAP flaws; partial fixes available; immediate exposure reduction recommended. ICS Advisory State-sponsored pre-positioning via SOHO/IoT router botnets (China-nexus) and exploitation of edge devices (PRC APT campaigns), heightening perimeter compromise risk. Security Advisory Security Advisory Pro-Russia hacktivist opportunistic access to exposed VNC on HMIs/SCADA causing loss of view and setpoint manipulation; immediate removal of Internet-exposed VNC required. items: China-nexus campaigns leveraging SOHO/IoT botnets and edge-device CVEs to mask ingress and sustain espionage footholds near CI environments. Security Advisory Security Advisory
Iranian-affiliated activity modifying PLC logic and HMIs (US WWS/Energy), indicating capability and willingness to create operational impacts. Security Advisory

relevance: The current cycle includes multiple government-grade advisories explicitly focused on PLCs and HMI access, not just adjacent IT. These provide concrete IOCs, protocol indicators (S7comm, Modbus, CIP), and appliance paths (NetScaler/AAA theme directories) suitable for rapid hunting in industrial networks. Perimeter compromises (NetScaler, FortiGate, SonicWall, ASA/FTD) remain the most efficient route into ICS, especially when OT relies on shared identity, insufficient jump-host controls, or flat routing. EV charging system weaknesses highlight operational disruption potential in transportation/energy segments.

items: NetScaler ADC/Gateway CVE-2026-8452 (pre-auth RCE) - patch and hunt for webshells; restrict AAA/SAML interfaces. Security Advisory
LoadMaster (Progress/Kemp) CVE-2026-8037 (KEV) - command injection; remove public admin exposure and verify persistence. Alert
Zimbra (KEV) - OS command injection and separate ZCS zero-day webmail chain; rotate app passcodes and hunt SOAP/GAL abuse. Alert Security Advisory
Gitea (KEV) - code injection; audit repos, rotate tokens, and verify release artifacts. Alert
Oracle WebLogic/HTTP Server (KEV) - improper access control; harden proxies and review logs for abuse. Alert
EVSE/EV charging (Autel, EVbee) - OCPP/DataTransfer injection, unsigned firmware, NFC/USB paths. CISA Bulletin
Mitsubishi Electric FA network/PLC modules - remote UDP DoS; apply fixed firmware and enforce ICS DMZ. ICS Advisory
All-Line Fuel-Boss (PHP/IMAP/PHP-FPM) - RCE; partial vendor fixes; remove exposure for unfixed variants. ICS Advisory

descriptions: External Remote Services, Valid Accounts, and Exploit Public-Facing Applications (T1133, T1078, T1190)
Protocol Abuse: S7comm (TCP/102), Modbus, CIP/EtherNet/IP; VNC exposure; OCPP DataTransfer misuse
Webshells on appliances; reverse proxies and DNS/HTTPS dead-drop C2; credential interception via PCAP on routers
Lateral movement via RDP/SMB/VDI; cloud exfil (OneDrive/Mega) and mailbox/API abuse (Zimbra SOAP)

outlook72h: NetScaler exploitation likely to surge; complete patching and webshell sweeps within 48 hours and rotate SSO/SAML secrets where exposure is suspected. Prioritize removal of any exposed VNC on HMIs; deploy geofencing/IP allowlists on OT remote access gateways immediately. Conduct a targeted hunt for S7comm writes and unexpected online changes on Siemens PLCs; validate program backups and restrict engineering workstation access. EVSE: enforce mTLS profiles and disable unsigned/URL-based firmware update paths; audit OCPP endpoints and broker connectivity.
